MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #6
====

GRADE: PP2
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What is 8 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 65
   B. 0
   C. 16
   D. 64

2. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 6 cm and 8 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 14
   B. 2
   C. 10
   D. 12

3. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 49
   B. 50
   C. 14
   D. 7

4. Solve for x: x + 5 = 16. (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 12
   C. 11
   D. 16

5. What is 4 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 0
   B. 17
   C. 8
   D. 16

6. In the number 3543, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 40
   C. 400
   D. 10

7. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 10
   C. 25
   D. 26

8. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 18
   B. 82
   C. 9
   D. 81

9. In the number 3143, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 40
   C. 10
   D. 400

10. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 13
   B. 170
   C. 26
   D. 169

11. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 121
   B. 122
   C. 11
   D. 22

12. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 156
   C. 144
   D. 48

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 70 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

14. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 75 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

15. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 80 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

Final Answer: 64
